title: Weird
subtitle: New Weird category with a B4 censor beep that's generated live and plays for as long as you hold the button.

title: Installable Sillyboard
subtitle: Sillyboard is now a PWA: install it to your home screen, the UI loads instantly from cache and only updates when the cloud copy changes, and sounds are saved on your device after the first play. Ogg Opus is now the default sound format (WAV still available in Labs), and the Cbat sounds that weren't loading are fixed.

title: Major Update I
subtitle: Refactored the way that Sillyboard is loaded, added a brand-new way of storing sounds, which cuts the file size by an order of magnitude.

title: Quality of Life? But I hardly know her!
subtitle: Tweaked how the arrow buttons behave, fixed category scrolling on iOS. Fixed broken STOP and HOLD button justification- and gave those buttons the fade treatment, too!

title: Slidy Slid
subtitle: I'm finally doing something with the extra room the new thinner arrows. Now, you can change the pitch right from the home screen! There's also a stop button.... finally.

title: When she sound on my board till I cache
subtitle: Sounds now load on-demand! They surprisingly didn't do that before :3... this wasn't a big issue because everything was *mostly* kept in cache- but it caused issues across multiple platforms where the sounds would hang or fail to start entirely. Also made the UX a little eaiser to use. I've combined some menu items so things are easier to discover, and there's now an 'info' menu that shows credits!

title: What are you doing in my house!?
subtitle: Network-First caching before GTA VI?
description: I appear to have made an oopsie when designing the loading system, because allthough the sound buttons updated, the actual sounds and UX did not update on refresh- instead prioritizing the local copy, which could be weeks old.
